name: Visualise Rays
description: Trace rays from the scene's sources, for display: each ray as a polyline over its wall hits, with the scattered rays when scattering is on. Press Play to draw the rays growing from the sources as sound travels; the same button reads Pause while playing and holds them where they are, Rewind goes back to the start, the time slider scrubs and Speed sets how fast they grow. Nothing is drawn before Play or a time. The Preview button shows or hides the drawing.

inputParameters.name: source_idx
inputParameters.description: Index of the source to trace from, in the order of the scene's sources. Empty (default): every source.

inputParameters.name: max_order
inputParameters.description: Highest reflection order traced per ray.

inputParameters.name: direction
inputParameters.description: Axis of a spotlight cone to emit the rays into, apex at each source. Empty (default): all directions. Needs angle.

inputParameters.name: angle
inputParameters.description: Half angle of the spotlight cone in degrees. Empty (default): all directions. Needs direction.

inputParameters.name: scattering
inputParameters.description: Also trace scattered rays at the reflections (default False).

inputParameters.name: seed
inputParameters.description: Seed of the scattered rays' random directions. Empty (default): a new seed each run. Only scattering uses it.

inputParameters.name: order
inputParameters.description: Draw only the first reflections of each ray. Empty (default): all traced orders. The ray_field output stays whole.

inputParameters.name: time
inputParameters.description: Time in ms. Alone: the rays as far as sound has travelled at that time (a slider scrubs). With Play: where playback stops (default: the end).

inputParameters.name: speed
inputParameters.description: Playback speed, a factor of the default, which draws the whole ray field in 10 s: 0.5 is half as fast, 2 twice.

outputParameters.name: rays
outputParameters.description: The rays as polylines from the source over the wall hits, up to order.

outputParameters.name: scattered
outputParameters.description: The scattered rays as polylines; empty without scattering.
